nodes.title: Start new gens by making sure 'Enable Final Pass' is\nturned offthen click Manual Random Seed button below
After the First Pass Sample Previews finishes, select which of\nthe 3 looks best below. Then continue right ->
When you've selected which Sample Preview to upscale, enable the below toggle\nthen continue right ->

Start your upscale by clicking the below button. If you don't like the result, you can reroll\nby clicking the button as many times as you like to get variations of the first pass! (Unless\nyou change something like prompt, resolution, refs, ANYTHING that happened before this step)
Don't worry if RIFE or Final Video have a red outline, it just means\nthere's no output going there on this run. It's a big fake scary 'error' but doesn't prevent anything.

widgets_values:
.: V2V Editing (replace a character in a target video) --- NOTE: TENDS TO LOOK BETTER ON SINGLE PASS. SEE OPTION ABOVE ---

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the girl whose motion comes from <Video 1> and whose appearance comes from <Picture 1>.
<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. The girl's appearance is styled from <Picture 1>. Her motion, camera movement, background, and lighting from the video are preserved continuously from start to finish without deviation at any point.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - the girl's face, body proportions, and skin tone from <Picture 1> are retained, and her motion, choreography, rhythm, and timing from <Video 1> are retained at every moment. 
<Video 1> (whole-video temporal structure, motion path, camera movement, background, lighting): fully_preserved - the girl's choreography, movement speed, gestures, body positions, camera framing, camera movement, background, and lighting from every frame of <Video 1> are preserved throughout the entire target video without deviation.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a naturalistic style matching the source footage, preserving its original lighting, color grading, and camera work.
[Shot 1] The camera follows <Subject 1>, the girl, as she exists in the same setting from <Video 1>. Her appearance matches <Picture 1> — same skin tone, body shape, and natural contours. Throughout the entire video, her motion is a frame-by-frame motion match to <Video 1>: the same choreography, gestures, limb positions, movement speed, and rhythm are followed continuously from start to finish. The camera framing, angle, and movement stay locked to <Video 1> at all times. The background remains identical and unchanged.


.: Reference Generation (general filmmaking):

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the character in <Picture 1>. (basic description)

<Subject 2> is the scene location in <Picture 2>. (basic scene description)

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] highly realistic live-action scene of <Subject 1> in <Subject 2>.

retention_analysis:
<Audio 1>: reference - the target speaker follows <Audio 1>'s voice timbre and measured delivery without copying the original signal.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1]: a close up shot of <Subject 1> with a shocked expression as the camera pulls in towards her face. Suddenly, she turns around to look behind her.
[Shot 2]: a 3/4ths shot of <Subject 1> as she turns, her expression is confused. She tilts her head to one side, a look of questioning. She hesitantly says using <Audio 1> as her vocal-timbre reference: <d>[English]Hello?.. Is anyone there?</d> her tone is hesitant and suspicious.
[Shot 3]: an over-the-shoulder following shot as <Subject 1> begins to walk through <Subject 2> looking around side to side.
 
overall_soundscape:
interior ambience

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the warrior in <Picture 1>, a stocky broad-shouldered fighter with a weathered face, short dark beard, and wind-tousled dark hair, wearing scuffed leather-and-bronze plate armor under a thick fur-trimmed cloak.
<Subject 2> is the misty rocky ridge in <Picture 2>, with jagged grey stone outcrops, tattered cloth banners staked into the ground, and low fog drifting across the surface.
<Subject 3> is the pair of bolster pillows in <Picture 3>, soft cylindrical shapes with a faded striped fabric pattern and visibly creased, worn seams, each with one end gathered like a blade's hilt, resting on the ground like legendary relic weapons.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows <Subject 1> standing atop <Subject 2>, turning toward the horizon, then closing their grip on the hilt-end of <Subject 3> with the weight and reverence of drawing legendary blades and raising them overhead, while an off-screen narrator speaks.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - armor, cloak, beard, and build are retained throughout.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - rocky outcrops, banners, and drifting fog are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the soft striped fabric and rumpled seams are retained exactly as referenced, never rigid or metallic, gripped only by the gathered end.

detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic epic-fantasy game-trailer style, with dramatic warm backlighting, richly detailed textures, and a painterly amber color grade.
[Shot 1] A wide low-angle static shot frames <Subject 2>, the misty rocky ridge, its jagged outcrops catching the low golden sun through drifting fog, tattered banners snapping in the wind. <Subject 1> stands center frame, back three-quarters to camera, then turns their profile toward the horizon, jaw set, eyes narrowed against the light, cloak pulled by the wind. An off-screen narrator (S1), in a deep, weathered bass-baritone voice, native French speaker, speaking at an extremely slow and deliberate pace with heavy pauses, entirely without warmth, says, <d>[French] Dans un monde où le sommeil est une arme.</d>
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera pushes in from a low angle toward <Subject 1>, who crouches beside <Subject 3>, the two bolster pillows on the ground, and closes each hand tightly around the gathered hilt-end of one pillow, gripping it exactly as a warrior's hand would close around the hilt of a legendary blade, never touching the loose trailing length. They rise to full height and lift <Subject 3> together directly overhead by these hilt-ends, arms locked, cloak billowing outward, the loose fabric trailing down from each grip like the blunted length of a blade. Expression stays completely grave — no glance toward camera, no smile.

overall_soundscape:
A steady, gusting wind continues throughout, with the intermittent snap of loose banner fabric.

non_diegetic_music:
A low sustained orchestral chord swells through Shot 1, joined by a sharp orchestral sting exactly as the grip closes at the start of Shot 2, building to a peak on the overhead raise.
